confidence.title: Tool description changed since last scan
confidence.detail: Tool "open_browser" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Open a remote browser in the cloud using CloudBrowser.ai" → after: "Open one remote browser in the cloud with the connected CloudBrowser account. Use it only for websites and accounts that the user owns or is authorized to use, and follow their terms. Browsers open without stealth fingerprints."

confidence.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
